WITH status_averages AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(rfistat, '(no status)') AS status,
         AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex
  FROM signals
  WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY COALESCE(rfistat, '(no status)')
), qualifying AS (
  SELECT status, avg_modindex
  FROM status_averages
  WHERE avg_modindex > (SELECT AVG(modindex) FROM signals WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL)
)
SELECT status,
       avg_modindex,
       avg_modindex - (SELECT AVG(modindex) FROM signals WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL) AS above_overall_average,
       avg_modindex - (SELECT AVG(avg_modindex) FROM qualifying) AS difference_from_qualifying_status_mean
FROM qualifying;
